summary: I work across the full stack on production web, mobile and AI products. On the backend I build REST APIs with Laravel, Node/Express and FastAPI, backed by MySQL, PostgreSQL, Redis and SQLite, with token and session auth, background workers and queues. On the frontend I ship Vue, Nuxt, React and Next.js in TypeScript and Tailwind, including server-side rendering, KO/EN internationalisation and offline-capable PWAs. I also build and release a native Android app in Kotlin with Jetpack Compose. I've integrated LLM APIs and on-device ONNX computer-vision models, and built realtime features with Pusher and Server-Sent Events. I own delivery end to end — Playwright, Vitest, PHPUnit and pytest suites, Bitbucket Pipelines CI/CD, and Docker deployments to AWS Lightsail behind nginx — working in Jira and testing APIs with Postman.

My tech stack here was WAMP. I mainly used Laravel for backend and native HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Tailwind, Vue and Quasar for frontend. I used Capacitor to convert web apps to mobile, backed by a Laravel REST API, with Axios for consuming APIs and Postman for testing them. Every website I developed had a custom content management system built from scratch and tailored to the client's needs. I worked across a range of site categories — brochure sites, e-commerce and booking platforms — and integrated payment providers including Stripe, PayMongo and Maya, plus delivery APIs from Lalamove and Transportify.

company: Provincial Government of Davao de Oro
summary: I worked on a module for a vehicle transport application system, using Laravel with MySQL on the backend and a templated Bootstrap admin UI on the frontend. Because the project was split into modules across the team, I used Git and GitHub to collaborate and keep my work integrated.
